hero.title: Small steps,
hero.description: Understand your type 2 diabetes risk factors and find thoughtful guidance to care for yourself, at your own pace.
hero.trust: Your information is handled with care
hero.visualAlt: Illustration of wellbeing and supportive guidance

how.title: Understanding is
how.description: Swira turns health information into clear guidance to help you make informed decisions.
how.step1Text: Answer simple questions about your health and daily habits, at your own pace.
how.step2Text: Explore an informative estimate that considers different parts of your wellbeing.
how.step3Text: Get practical ideas to discuss with a health professional and care for your health.

privacy.title: We care for your health.
privacy.description: Health information is personal. Swira is designed to handle your data thoughtfully and transparently as we build each part of the platform.
privacy.point1: Protected connections between your device and Swira
privacy.point3: We use your data to provide guidance
privacy.visualCaption: Designed with your privacy in mind

about.title: Technology with
about.description: Swira is a project in development that aims to make preventive information and guidance about type 2 diabetes easier to access. We want understanding your risk factors to feel simpler, more accessible, and useful for starting an informed conversation about your health.
about.note: You can write anonymously to the contact email: airam2ww@gmail.com
about.messageRequired: Please write a message before continuing.
about.draftReady: Form validated. Email delivery will be enabled later; your message has not been sent.

disclaimer.title: Guidance, not a diagnosis.
disclaimer.text: Swira provides educational information and an informative estimate; it does not replace assessment, diagnosis, or treatment by a health professional. If you have concerns, talk with a medical professional.
